milestone.title: raul two-line footer — globals on line 1, per-tab keys on line 2

intent.outcome: Users see global keybinds (quit, help, refresh, lane-switch, sort, hide-done) and per-tab keybinds simultaneously. No mode-switching, no guesswork.

problem.description: Today's footer is one line that shows whichever keybinds match the current (lane, content_state). Globals are visible only when they also appear in the per-tab set, so basic navigation is easy to miss for new users. The new lifecycle filter (F) and fuzzy search (/) keybinds landing in M184–M186 need a visible surface; the footer is the natural place.

in_scope: chrome.rs renders the footer as two horizontal lines: globals on line 1, per-tab on line 2

Globals surfaced on line 1: quit (q), help (?), refresh (r), prev-lane (Tab/Shift-Tab), next-lane (Tab), sort-rebind (S), cycle-sort (o), hide-done (h), filter (F, placeholder binding for M185), search (/, placeholder binding for M186)
Per-tab keybinds stay on line 2, dispatched from existing Keybinds::footer_* methods
Footer area math in view_state.rs splits footer_area into globals_top + per_tab_bottom
Truncation rules (per existing format_flash_footer_with_details helpers) apply per line, not across both
out_of_scope: The lifecycle filter modal itself (lands in M185)
The fuzzy search modal itself (lands in M186)
Adding any new actions to the keybind dispatcher; this milestone only re-renders the footer surface
Compaction to a single line on short terminals (per design decision: always show two lines)
Touching the lane enum or any lane-related code outside the footer renderer

design_decisions.choice: Split the existing footer_area Rect at render time into globals_top + per_tab_bottom; view_state math stays as one footer_area
design_decisions.rationale: Keeps view_state.rs simple (no layout rewiring); the renderer is the single place that picks which keys go on which line. Splitting the area in chrome.rs makes the render order explicit.

design_decisions.choice: Hand-curated list of globals in chrome.rs (not auto-derived from Keybinds)
design_decisions.rationale: Some Keybinds entries are lane-scoped (e.g., filter is only useful on Milestones) and shouldn't pollute the global line. A hand-curated list keeps the global line stable and predictable.

design_decisions.choice: F and / appear as labelled-but-unbound placeholders on line 1 until M185/M186 ship
design_decisions.rationale: Surfaces upcoming keybinds to the user so the footer reflects the target shape early. The placeholder style is dim; the keys take effect once their respective milestones land.

work_packages.name: footer renderer
work_packages.goal: chrome.rs renders two horizontal lines (globals on line 1, per-tab on line 2); footer area math splits footer_area into globals_top + per_tab_bottom
work_packages.rollback: Revert chrome.rs to a single-line footer; Keybinds::footer_* methods and existing per-tab dispatch unchanged.

steps.action: Refactor chrome.rs to render two horizontal lines from the existing footer_area: split into globals_top (line 1) and per_tab_bottom (line 2). The split happens in chrome.rs, not view_state.rs (keep view_state footer_area math as-is). Add a hand-curated list of globals: q (quit), ? (help), r (refresh), Tab/Shift-Tab (lane switch), S (sort rebind), o (cycle sort — placeholder until M186), h (hide-done), F (filter placeholder), / (search placeholder). F, /, o are labelled but unbound until M185/M186 ship — the placeholder style is dim. Three edge cases pinned: (a) if footer_area.height < 2, fall back to a single line carrying globals only; (b) the existing flash-message path (format_flash_footer_with_details) still renders correctly — flash messages span both rows as a single Paragraph; (c) mouse hit-test on the footer remains a no-op (no keybind is mouse-clickable) — verify runner.rs mouse handler is unaffected by the area split.
steps.done_when: Two Paragraph widgets render in footer_area, the first carrying globals and the second carrying per-tab; truncation rules apply per line.

steps.action: Wire the per-tab line content to the existing Keybinds::footer_* dispatch (footer_overview, footer_milestones, footer_path, footer_backlog, footer_ideas, footer_watch, footer_settings). Additionally, add modal-mode branches for Mode::LifecycleFilter (placeholder text: '↑↓ navigate · Space toggle · ⏎ commit · Esc revert') and Mode::SearchInput (placeholder text: 'type to filter · ⏎ commit · Esc cancel'). Placeholders render dim until M185/M186 ship. Verify on all 7 lanes that the per-tab content matches what each lane's footer_* returns today.
steps.done_when: Switching to each of the 7 lanes renders the matching per-tab footer on line 2; a test exercises each lane.

steps.action: Confirm an existing raul config that references a Tweaks-specific keybind (TWEAK_OPEN or similar) still loads without panic — the key is silently a no-op and the footer renders the remaining globals + per-tab line normally. A warning is acceptable in this rc.
steps.done_when: Loading a config with an unknown keybind name does not panic; the test pins the no-panic behavior.

steps.action: Run the canonical lint gate and validate the plan: cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy -p raul --tests --no-deps -- -D warnings, and mp validate all pass.

findings.description: compute_overview_list_rects places lower_inbox/lower_activity at top_chunks[3].y + PATH_HEIGHT (const 7) even in compact mode where path_h is 6. On a 24x80 Overview the lower panels land on footer y (y=22) outside content_area. Short flash text and non-full-width globals leave dashboard box-drawing visible on the footer row (e.g. flash Saved 3 setting(s) shows box-drawing + Recent activity). M183 2-line footer made the bleed obvious; root cause is PATH_HEIGHT vs path_h mismatch. Fix: anchor lower panels at path.y + path.height (or path_h) and clamp to content; clear footer area before paint.
findings.summary: Overview compact lower panels overlap footer_area

findings.description: render_footer paints Paragraph widgets that only write text cells. Unpainted cells in footer_area retain prior buffer content. Combined with layout bleed (or any future overlay into footer rows), short flash messages and short globals lines show leftover chrome. Fix: frame.render_widget(Clear, area) before painting footer content. Pins AC-01/S1 flash path spanning both rows cleanly.
findings.summary: render_footer does not clear footer_area before paint

findings.description: view_state compact layout triggers on content_area.height < 32; dashboard_view.rs uses frame.area().height < 32. After M183 content_area = frame_h - 4, so at frame heights 32..35 view_state allocates compact chunk heights while dashboard_view still emits rich multi-line content into those short rects (clipped/wrong density). Fix: share one compact predicate (content height or a flag on DashboardChunks) between compute_overview_list_rects and render_dashboard.
findings.summary: dashboard compact flag desynced from view_state after 2-line footer
